name: tribooo-firestore
description: Reglas, índices, catálogos y pruebas de Firestore para Tribooo

scripts.test: npm run rules:check && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-tribooo "node --test tests/"
scripts.emulators: npm run rules:gen && firebase emulators:start --project demo-tribooo
scripts.deploy: npm test && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes --project tribooo
scripts.setup: npm run deploy && npm run seed
